description: R-OPS-1 allow-list: the only paths below D:\mri_project that may change across an owner run of select (fnmatch patterns relative to the project root; '*' matches '/' too). Cited: spec R-OPS-1, D-10; the README sections on report files and on keeping code and data apart.
notes: The names of rotated log copies are not stated in the README; 'Reports/pipeline.log.*' covers the usual RotatingFileHandler names. If the owner's run shows another rotated name, the testing agent records it as a finding for the owner to classify, without widening this list.
